دَمْرَآءُ A ewe, or she-goat, having little milk. (K.) ―
-b2- And One short in make. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Applied to a woman, and to others, [i. e. applied also to a company of people, جَمَاعَةٌ, (TK,)] Wont to intrude upon others; to go, or come, in to them without permission. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
